Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. We deliver cutting-edge solutions that are paving the way for the next generation of digital banking and payments, but our true impact begins with our associates. If you're ready to help transform an industry and grow with a company that values purpose, collaboration, and excellence then we’d love to meet you.
The Data Engineer works within the Data & Analytics organization as part of the Warehousing & Pipelines team. This role is responsible for designing, developing, modernizing, and supporting enterprise data integration solutions that power operational processes, analytics, reporting, machine learning, and enterprise data initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering skills with deep data platform expertise and is passionate about building reliable, scalable, and maintainable data systems using modern engineering practices. This position offers opportunities for advancement for a well-qualified, driven candidate.
This is a remote position and candidates must live within approximately a 70-mile radius of our office locations in Allen, TX; Birmingham, AL; Cedar Falls; IA; Charlotte, NC; Louisville, KY; Overland Park, KS; Springfield, MO; or Monett, MO.
This position is ineligible for immigration sponsorship and support. Please do not apply if at any time you will need immigration support now or in the future (i.e., H-1B, PERM).
All positions, regardless of location, may require an in-person interview or onboarding requirement to verify your identity.
What you’ll be responsible for:
Works within the Data & Analytics team in the Warehousing & Pipelines function, collaborating closely with DBAs, Data Architects, BI Developers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and business stakeholders. Designs, develops, tests, deploys, and maintains batch and streaming data pipelines supporting payment processing systems with strict availability and performance requirements. Develops data integration solutions using SQL, C#, Python, PowerShell, and related automation technologies. Develops and supports event-driven architectures using Change Data Capture (CDC), Kafka, messaging platforms, and stream-processing technologies. Develops, maintains, and modernizes legacy data integration solutions, including SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), transitioning workloads toward code-first, version-controlled development practices. Creates and maintains CI/CD pipelines for data integration, analytics, and data platform solutions. Implements monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability capabilities for data platforms and pipelines. Works with Data Architects and enterprise data governance teams to populate and maintain enterprise data warehouse, lakehouse, and analytical data platform solutions. Tunes SQL queries and database interactions to reduce impact on source systems and improve application performance. Optimizes data pipelines to improve throughput, scalability, resiliency, and cost efficiency. Produces and maintains technical documentation, architectural diagrams, operational runbooks, and deployment procedures. Leverages AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve productivity and code quality while independently validating, reviewing, and testing all generated code. Participates in on-call rotations and provides after-hours support as required. May perform other job duties as assigned. What you’ll need to have:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering. Minimum of 3 years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or database development. Experience developing solutions on relational database platforms such as SQL Server and/or MySQL. Experience developing applications or services using C# or similar object-oriented programming languages. Experience developing and supporting ETL/ELT and data integration solutions. Experience working with source control systems such as Git and participating in code reviews and pull request workflows. Experience working with containerization technologies such as Docker. What would be nice for you to have:
Experience modernizing legacy analytics platforms, OLAP solutions, or analytical workloads. Experience with cloud services and data platforms in GCP, AWS, and/or Azure. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep, Ansible, or similar technologies. Experience building and supporting Kubernetes-based applications and services. Experience developing data lakes, lakehouses, and open table format solutions using technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Hudi, Parquet, or similar platforms. Experience operating under PCI DSS, SOC, financial services, healthcare, or similar regulatory frameworks. If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this opportunity. Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement on this posting, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who align with our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team.

At Jack Henry, we live by the motto: “ Do the right thing, do whatever it takes, and have fun.” It’s more than a tagline, it’s the foundation of our culture. We recognize that our associates are the key to our success, and we’re deeply committed to their wellbeing. That’s why we offer comprehensive benefits designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health so you can thrive both personally and professionally.
We’re also leading the way in technology modernization, helping financial institutions evolve with speed, security, and flexibility. Our strategy focuses on delivering secure data access, mitigating fraud, and enabling seamless integration. Empowering our teams to build innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of accountholders.
Culture of Commitment
Ask our associates why they love Jack Henry, and many will tell you it is because our culture is exceptional. We do great things together. Our culture empowers us to rise to challenges, seek new opportunities, and support one another through change. It’s this shared commitment that drives our success. We’re proud to foster an environment where inclusion, sustainability, and community impact are more than values, they’re how we operate. Visit our Corporate Sustainability site to learn more about our culture and commitment to our people, customers, community, environment, and shareholders.
Equal Employment Opportunity
At Jack Henry, we know we are better together. We value, respect, and protect the uniqueness each of us brings. Innovation flourishes by including all voices and makes our business - and our society - stronger. Jack Henry is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing equal opportunity in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, performance management, promotion, transfer, compensation, benefits, education, training, social, and recreational activities to all persons regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, and military and veteran status, or any other protected status protected by local, state or federal law.
No one will be subject to, and Jack Henry prohibits, any form of discipline, reprisal, intimidation, or retaliation for good faith reports or complaints of discrimination of any kind, pursuing any discrimination claim, or cooperating in related investigations.
Please be aware that Jack Henry recruiters will only email you from our domain, jackhenry.com. If you receive an email from any other domain, please do not click any of those links, open attachments, or share personal information.
Requests for full corporate job descriptions may be requested through the interview process at any time.

The Expertise You Have • 3-5 years of experience in data engineering, data analysis, software engineering, internships, or related projects. • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field. • Basic understanding of databases and SQL. • Interest in cloud technologies, AI, and machine learning. Preferred Qualifications • Internship or project experience using SQL, Python, or cloud technologies. • Exposure to healthcare, insurance, or financial services data. • Experience with reporting or visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. • Strong interest in AI and machine learning applications.

This is a remote role that may be hired in several markets across the United States. Priority given to those candidates located in the area of **Raleigh, North Carolina, Phoenix, Arizona and Dallas,Texas**.

We are seeking a motivated **Data Engineer** to join our **Data Platform Engineering Organization** and help build scalable cloud-based data solutions that enable analytics and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on data engineer with experience in cloud-based data platforms, data warehousing, ETL/ELT development, and modern data engineering practices. This individual will contribute to the development and support of scalable data pipelines, integrations, and data products utilizing AWS Services, Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, and related technologies.  
  
As part of our growing Cloud Data & AI Platform organization, you will collaborate with a talented team of engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders to modernize enterprise data platforms and deliver cloud-based data solutions that support critical business initiatives. This is an opportunity to work with modern technologies, solve complex data challenges, and contribute to the bank's data and AI transformation journey.

  
**Responsibilities & Qualifications**  
  

**Duties and Responsibilities**:

The successful candidate will thrive in a collaborative environment, possess problem-solving skills, and be passionate about building reliable, scalable, and high-quality data solutions.

* Design, build, and support scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data solutions utilizing AWS Services, Snowflake, dbt, Python, SQL, and related technologies.
* Implement data warehouse solutions, dimensional data models, and ETL/ELT processes that support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence capabilities.
* Implement data quality validations, test cases, and controls to ensure accurate, consistent, and reliable data assets.
* Develop and maintain data tests, including dbt tests, to support data quality and reliability requirements.
* Support workflow orchestration, monitoring, troubleshooting, log analysis, and production operations using Airflow and cloud-native technologies.
* Collaborate with business users, product partners, analysts, and technology teams to deliver data solutions that support business objectives.
* Follow established engineering standards, development practices, documentation requirements, and testing procedures to support high-quality solution delivery.
* Participate in pipeline deployments, environment promotion activities, operational support, and performance optimization efforts using established CI/CD processes.
* Leverage AI-powered development and productivity tools to improve engineering efficiency, code quality, and delivery outcomes.

**Qualifications****:**

  
Bachelor's Degree and 1 year experience

OR

High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 5 years' experience

**Preferred Area of Study**: Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related field  
  

**Preferred Area of Experience**: Data engineering, database management, or related field. Experience with cloud-based data platforms and big data technologies  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with enterprise ETL/ELT tools such as DataStage, SAP BODS, SSIS, Informatica, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with Operational Data Stores (ODS), analytics platforms, and data products.
* Experience working with cloud-based and on-premises data environments.
* Exposure to Data Vault modeling and modern data warehousing methodologies.
* Understanding of data governance, security, compliance, and data quality management practices.
* Experience within Financial Services, Banking, or other highly regulated industries.
* Familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or other analytics and visualization platforms.
* Experience using AI-powered development and productivity tools to improve engineering efficiency and delivery outcomes.
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified Developer – Associate, AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, SnowPro Core Certification, or equivalent cloud and data platform certifications.
